svg.title: lucasFireC2F data blueprint: national datasets and the stages that read them
svg.text: The national datasets lucasFireC2F reads, the stages that read them, what for, and the option that switches each one · version 2.4.0
read only when a shortcut row is filled

g.text: LF 2020 (2.2.0) · FBFM40, CBD, CBH, CC, CH · 30 m
The zone's 150 m fuel, canopy, elevation, zone, fire-age and vegetation maps, and its boundary
Set by: Zone Preparation Options (zone, buffer, vintages)
Ignition probability maps per cause, from a GAM on ten 30 m covariates
Set by: Zone Preparation Options (ignition fire size, years, buffer)
Daily weather of each weather zone on the grid
Set by: Data Sources (gridMET build, or a prebuilt table)
Severity class shares by fuel group, the target stage 8 fits to
Set by: Zone Preparation Options (severity years)
Burning-period wind ratio table for stages 6 and 8
Set by: Wind Table Options (months, years, hours, distance)
The zone's recorded fires (Historical Fires): date, size, cause, location
Set by: Fire Record Import; Fire Record Sources
AUC of burn probability against large MTBS fires, and against the benchmark
Set by: Validation Options; Validation Period
Report figures and the tables behind the Charts tab
Set by: Run Control; the results of the stages that ran

svg.text: Wires run from a dataset to each stage that reads it, coloured by the stage. Vintages are those the user guide lists (section 2.1). Every dataset is national, so one project's rows serve any pyrome in CONUS.
The other stages read only datasheets. Generated by docs/blueprint/build-data.R from package.xml (lucasFireC2F 2.4.0), 2026-10-30.
